t: r/GlobalOffensive on Reddit: Autoexec.cfg for CS:GO
r/GlobalOffensive on Reddit: Can someone tell me quickly where is location of autoexec.cfg?

s: It mary vary a bit per user, but generally speaking you'll want to place your .cfg into: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Counter-Strike Global Offensive\csgo\cfg The autoexec file itself is just a configuration that CS:GO will pull settings from that are either too cumbersome to mess with via in-game menus, or users would like to set in numerical values rather than attempt to use the menu-based options.
